tei:div.tei:p: "$ (439)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge snying po grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(440)༄༅// dkyil 'khor dbang phyug rigs mchog drug /gcig bsdus khyab bdag rdo rje sems// bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhabs// dad brgya'i gtsug gi nor bus mchog /khro phu lo tsā ba chen po las rim par brgyud pa'i dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang sgrub pa la gsum// sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ stegs bu khebs ldan gyi dbus su maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar tshom bu sngon po gcig bkod// ma 'dzom na me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu gcig bkod pas kyang rung*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga zlum gtor rnams mdun du bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril dang 'thor nas/ las rdor nas maṇ+ḍal dang*/ bsang chu rnams sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ sgrub thabs dang*/ rjes gnang ngo*// dang po la skyabs sems ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ sogs lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ārma ko3 haṃ/ zhes dang stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ rlung me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po pad+ma dang*/ zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni (441)bdud kyi mgor/ zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa/ lha yi dbang pos btud pa'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskums pas dbang phyug dkar po dang*/ g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying ga mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/

mthe chung ljang khu/ phyag sor rnams kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o// rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan cing*/ me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa (442)'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ dbu skra phyed grol ba'o// gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥser po/ gtsug tor du haṃ ljang khu/ gsang ba sngon po rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes pa'o// snying gar rnam bcu dbang ldan brtsegs par bsams nas/ oṃ ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻྃ swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla bdag bskyed sgom bzlas kho na bya'i skabs su mthar mi dmigs par bzhag la dge ba bsngo/ 'dir bzlas pa grub pa dang mchod pa byin rlabs ste/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 ho/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs sil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu dpag tu med par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pād+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sā pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dha sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gsal ba ni/ rlung me chu dang sogs bdag bskyed ltar la/ haṃ k+ṣa/ zhes gsal gdab/ mchod bstod med kyang chog mod/ spyi mthun byed na/ oṃ shrī krā la tsakra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/

sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ stong nyid snying rje sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas dmigs gsal gdab la snying po ci rigs bzla/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swā bhā ba sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ sangs rgyas yab yum sras dang bcas pa g.yog 'khor dang*/ (443)grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*/ mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ zhes mdun tu spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ ār+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da bar gyis mchod la/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// srid gsum skye 'jigs med pa'i dngos// shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku// dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gnyis pa rjes gnang ni/ slob ma rnams la phyi rol du khrus kyi phyir chab btang*/ gral la 'khod de me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de la 'dir/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma lus pa'i snying po// bla na med pa'i rgyud sde thams cad kyi rgyal po// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i gshegs shul/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin byed la chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i dbang chen/ lha nyer lnga pa sogs dus 'khor nyid dang*/ sdom pa chen po sogs lha gzhan dang 'brel ba'i rnams grangs mang du 'byung ba las/ 'dir lha sgoms sngags bzlas kyi snod rung du byed pa bskyed rim thams cad kyi rtsa ba dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi rjes su gnang ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang grub thob rā hu la shrī nas rim par brgyud de/

pan chen bud+dha shrī las khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gyis gsan nas gangs can gyi ljongs su spel bar mdzad pa ste/ de la bdag nyid kyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams song zin/ khyed (444)rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces brda sbyar/ slob dpon rnams kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shig /rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyed la gsol 'debs gyi// ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir mdun bskyed kyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro bas byang chub kyi sems bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs gsum dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rjes gnang rtsal du gsol snyam pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shig /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ da rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad pa zhu/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ārma ko3 ho/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor ri rab lhun po rnams rim par brtsegs pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan bdud dang dbang phyug gi gdan la khyed rang rnams dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis sogs sgrub thabs ltar la/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥsngon po rnams su gsal bar gyur// da rjes gnang dngos gzhi gsum las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang ni/

de nas slob dpon yang rang gis bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer (445)'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ slob dpon dang mdun gyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par thim/ dril bu dang rol mo 'khrol/ spos dud bya'o// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la brtan g.yo thams cad 'dus pa'i yi ge ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻྃ zhes kha dog sna tshogs pa gsal ba/ de las sngags kyi yi ge gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻྃ zhes pa'i yi ge gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs snying ga'i yi ge la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig / sgrub thabs ltar snying po lan gsum brjod/ dang pos byin gyis brlabs// gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres// gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod// slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol//

zhes lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog (446)de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor phul ba'i mos pa mdzod cig / slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la// bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig /gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung dung ba dang*/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlab tu gsol snyam pa mdzad pas/ mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas phyag mtshan rdo rje dang dril bu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rgyangs te byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang grub pa lags pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig legs par bsrung snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyis dam tshig bzung*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ de nas brtsams te tshar gsum byas la dge ba bsngo/ gsum pa rjes mchod kha gsos la mdun bskyed skabs ltar mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya brjod// ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ mdun bskyed rang la bsdu/ ston mchog dam pa sogs kyis shis brjod bya'o// rgyun gyi rnal 'byor khyer bde zhing*// rdzogs rim rten du'ang bsngags mthong nas// khol byungs bkod las gshegs snying gi/ sgrib bral lha sku mngon byed shog /ces gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod kyi nang tshan zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi cha lag tu nye bar mkho ba la mtshams sbyar te blo gros mtha' yas kyi rdzong shod shangs kyi zab lung gnyis par sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol byung bklags chog tu bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// maṅga lam/
